title: Host salary ladder
intro: These are official-style BIGO Africa host salary examples used by Roxy BC. **Pay depends on hitting both the bean target and the live-hour target.** Higher S ranks continue up to S28. Figures can be updated by BIGO; ask us if a row looks different in the app.
note: Ranks between S1 and S28 exist; we did not invent the in-between numbers here. Hours marked “—” should be confirmed in the current official table inside the agency group.
payoutText: Hosts in Roxy BC who hit their targets that month were paid from **$32** up to **$620** (including F-rank and S2 results). This is a snapshot, not a promise of what you will earn. Your pay depends on your own beans, live hours, and BIGO’s process.
